data.title: Count ERROR lines per service in a log file
data.description: Read the application log and count how many ERROR-level lines each service produced. Return a dict with two keys: "error_counts", mapping each service name to its error count, and "total", the total number of error lines.

data.task_spec: Read the application log and count how many ERROR-level lines each service produced. Return a dict with two keys: "error_counts", mapping each service name to its error count, and "total", the total number of error lines.

data.reasoning: The agent reads the log via read_log_file (passing a path from task_input when provided, with a no-arg fallback), then scans each returned line for a whole-word ERROR level token. For each matching line it extracts the service name using layered heuristics in order of reliability: an explicit key=value pair (service=/svc=/logger=), a bracketed [service] group (preferring one adjacent to the level token), or the token immediately following the ERROR marker stripped of punctuation; unresolvable lines fall back to "unknown".
